scope: all 1130 BioASQ list questions, provided snippets, retrospective source-group split

source_manifest.partition_method: Question/paper-identifier connected groups across all types, fixed SHA256 buckets 20/20/60, with previously used connected groups assigned to development_seen.
source_manifest.data_status: Retrospective partition of a provided training corpus after offline audit, not official BioASQ test and not a previously untouched blind set.
source_manifest.reference_visibility: Only references.json contains exact/ideal labels; never send to models.
limitations: Canonical identifiers do not resolve every PMID/PMCID/DOI equivalence.
All ineligible and failed items must remain in reporting denominators.
Models may have pretrained on public data; no contamination-free claim.

model_sha256_from_existing_deployment_re.verification: recorded at deployment; not rehashed for this launch

phases: discovery baseline/shared-observation arms and bounded proposal
failure_policy: Every item retained; format/context/task-tool errors yield explicit status and empty prediction scored zero. Any failed extraction chunk makes shared-observation arms empty; raw partial output remains for diagnostics. At most one identical format retry per operation, counted. Infrastructure HTTP/connection failures halt the study for checkpoint resume instead of sweeping remaining questions as wrong.
chunking: At most 3 snippets and 12000 source characters per extraction request; long snippets split into 12000-character overlapping segments, original evidence IDs retained. Full originals remain for quote checking.
submission_renderer: Same for trusted/generated aggregation: first 100 normalized distinct answer items, excluding >512-character display names. Raw unbounded tool output retained. Offline adaptation: supplied labels reach 230 characters, so the competition's 100-character answer cap is not applied.
primary_metric: Pinned BioASQ Java evaluator mean list F1 on all evaluation questions; local exact lowercased one-to-one alias P/R/F1 for per-item diagnostics
secondary: paired F1 difference 95% percentile CI with 2000 source-group bootstrap replicates, seed 20261106
reference_policy: Exact/ideal answers stay offline. Manager receives redacted eligibility/completeness; Coder receives generic contract and synthetic tests.
resume_policy: Only this run's hash-matched completed operations; no old development answers, observations, Manager plans or candidates imported.
interpretation: Training corpus, not official blind BioASQ test
Official evaluator used offline with 512-character item cap adapted to this source; not a valid competition submission claim
Previously accessed source groups are not primary evaluation
Single prespecified run; no multiple-seed robustness claim
Two predefined contracts; no arbitrary new tool types
All source items remain, even unsupported/long/failed cases
Direct QA and chunk-reading arms have unequal compute; causal comparisons use shared observations
